_comment: Source of truth for rasterized UI icons (status/marker glyphs -- NOT the turn-by-turn maneuver arrows, which stay procedural in firmware/gui/nav_renderer.cpp + nav_icons_data.h; see docs/reference/gui_and_display.md for why). Consumed by tools/icons/build_icon_raster.py, which is the ONLY thing that should write firmware/gui/generated/*.h -- do not hand-edit those. `size_240` is the icon's square render size in pixels AUTHORED AGAINST THE 240px reference profile (prototype_c3_gc9a01); every other screen profile scales it by (profile.width / 240), the same convention nav_renderer.cpp uses for maneuver geometry against its 600-unit design diameter. All source SVGs here are Material Symbols with a square 0 -960 960 960 viewBox, so one size covers width and height.

location_on._comment: 54px, sized off the arrived pop-up's pin in 'design/screens/03-turn-by-turn/Arrived Pop Up.svg' (ink 36.67x45.83 there). ArrivedScreen is the only consumer; a future map marker wanting a different size needs its own entry rather than a resize here.
